name: Tsuzuki Yuuki
source:
A patient admitted to the "Nagashima Clinic,'' a clinic on a quiet hill. He's usually sleepy and a bit absent-minded, but he's just a normal college student.

After being hospitalized at the "Nagashima Clinic" where the story takes place, he experiences cloudy memories, such as things he can't remember and strange dreams.

Although he is somewhat slender, he has a strong physique, and has the strength to lift a single person. He is not the kind of person who uses force to suppress women, but is a gentle, kind and considerate person. He also has a normal sexual desire.

He realizes that he is a brutal magician with a sadistic hobby that he sees in his dreams every night. He gradually opens up to his "other self".
